fields.title: Bakame Community Hackathon
fields.description: A community hackathon and showcase event bringing together MbazaNLP contributors to demo the Bakame chatbot and discuss the roadmap for Kinyarwanda NLP tooling.

fields.title: MbazaNLP Community Sprint — June 2026
fields.description: A two-day community sprint focused on model evaluation, dataset contributions, and onboarding new contributors. Open to all skill levels — NLP researchers, developers, and translators all welcome.

fields.title: MbazaNLP @ IndabaX Rwanda 2024
fields.description: MbazaNLP community members presented open-source Kinyarwanda NLP work at IndabaX Rwanda, the local edition of the Deep Learning Indaba.
